verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows the Guichet unique (procedures.inpi.fr / inpi.fr) serving a real robots.txt. The only robots.txt probe targeted a different state host, annuaire-entreprises.data.gouv.fr, and got an HTTP 403 Incapsula shell rather than a policy file. The other probe only notes in passing that the filing front doors sit behind Incapsula shells, which does not show any published crawl policy for this product.
